L27@P0: The starting dose of the drugs detailed below may be adjusted downward by the prescribing clinician, using their independent

L29@P0: CARBOplatin is administered on day 1 and PACLitaxel is administered on day 1, 8 and 15 of a 21 day cycle for 4
L30@P0: cycles or until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity develops.
L31@P0: This is then followed by 4 cycles of DOXOrubicin and cycloPHOSphamide administered once every 14 days for
L32@P0: four cycles (one cycle = 14 days)

L39@P0: 2 1 CARBOplatin AUC 6 IV infusion 500mL glucose 5% over 30 minutes 1-4

L41@P0: microporous membrane
L42@P0: PACLitaxel should be diluted to a concentration of 0.3-1.2mg/mL.
L43@P0: Note: Administration volumes and fluids have been standardised to facilitate electronic prescribing system builds.
